title-group.article-title: A review of autism spectrum disorder interventions

license.license-p: This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 license.

abstract.p: This review summarises evidence for ASD interventions across multiple modalities and populations.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Autism spectrum disorder is a developmental condition that affects social communication.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We reviewed fifty studies of behavioural interventions for autistic children and adults.
